📌 [...] Hey everyone, Vinit here. Floor plan tools usually make you pick: easy and rough, or precise and slow. FloorGen tries to be both, and now you can just ask. 1. Draw: feet and inches to 1/16″, live dimensions, 27 templates. 2. Ask: tell FloorGen AI what you want. It proposes a plan, builds it, and checks its own work. Every change can be undone, and it stops to ask before deleting anything. 3. Check: IRC checks as you draw (plus Canada, UK, Germany and Mexico City profiles), and "Fix with AI" on each issue. 4. Walk through: every plan is a furnished 3D model, day or night. 5. Print: elevations and plan sets to scale, as PDF, DXF, SVG or glTF. For AI folks: Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor connect over MCP (149 tools), and their edits land live in the editor you have open. Designing needs no [...] land live in the editor you have open. Designing needs no account; FloorGen AI and sync need a free sign-in. Everything is free right now. Tell me what breaks and what you'd want next. I'm here all day. floorgen.app
